tasks.short: Research target audiences and turn evidence into a usable design brief.

steps.what: Clarify the audience question and intended design decision.
Gather audience reports and aggregate customer evidence.
Read public audience research through a web browser {OTHER} and capture relevant passages.

loop.input: Research question and a fixed batch of permitted public pages.
loop.output: Relevant passages with source links, dates and stated audience coverage.
loop.check: Verify quoted text against retrieved pages; the designer opens every cited link.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per page, at most 20 pages; flag inaccessible or unsupported material.
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience descriptions use varied prose; keyword matching cannot reliably extract context and limitations.

steps.what: Discuss evidence gaps and customer context with a market research analyst.
Write an audience summary with evidence, uncertainty and conflicting findings.

loop.input: Reviewed evidence pack, source notes and context notes.
loop.output: Audience summary with linked claims, contradictions and explicit unknowns.
loop.check: Require evidence references for factual claims; designer checks representativeness and unsupported inference.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported sections remain marked unknown for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template provides structure but cannot reconcile narrative evidence or express its limitations.

steps.what: Agree audience priorities and design implications with the marketing manager.

tasks.design: A reusable research pack starts with uploaded reports, then adds permitted aggregate exports from the {CRM} and {BI}. Deterministic retrieval and two bounded reading and drafting loops produce a cited summary in the {DOCS}; the designer checks sources and agrees the audience brief with the marketing manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence sits across reports, customer records and public prose. Connecting it took bespoke integration and repeated manual reading.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding can reduce the effort of building importers and citation checks. Bounded extraction can handle prose without granting autonomous browsing or decision authority.
tasks.still_hard: Missing audience evidence, biased samples and stale research remain. A polished summary cannot establish what customers actually need.
tasks.human_edge: The designer notices when audience categories hide meaningful differences and connects evidence to a specific communication decision.

ambition.what: Choose an evidence-backed audience emphasis before each campaign concept review.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less evidence hunting and more discussion of audience tradeoffs. The designer can recommend audience emphasis earlier; the marketing manager retains targeting approval.

reach.task: Assess whether an audience finding supports a campaign decision.
reach.learn: Sampling limits, source quality and the difference between observed behaviour and inferred preference.

evidence.claim: A cited research desk with designer source checks is a feasible bounded-loop design.
Aggregate exports and reusable evidence packs can reduce repeated collection work.
Time shares, remaining effort and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured results.

assumptions: This describes project research in a mid-size European marketing team.
Existing research is reused before commissioning new customer research.
Customer evidence can initially be supplied as permitted aggregate exports.
The priors support substantial gathering work; meeting time is concentrated in framing and interpretation.
Access estimates include privacy review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which audience reports and aggregate customer datasets the designer may access.
Whether research covers the intended audience, geography and channel.
Whether national consultation requirements apply to the proposed data use.
Actual research volume and time spent checking sources.
research_questions: Which citation checks best detect summaries that overstate the underlying audience evidence?
How reliably can extraction preserve sample limitations across common research formats?
new_work: Open cited sources and resolve unsupported claims.
Maintain source permissions, import mappings and freshness rules.
Check that summaries avoid personal data and unjustified audience stereotypes.
Record gaps that require new research.

tasks.short: Create computer artwork and charts, review them, and produce printed proofs.

steps.what: Gather approved content, data and specifications for the artwork.
Draw charts from supplied data using the design editor {OTHER}.
Draw illustrations and other artwork using the design editor {OTHER}.

loop.input: Approved visual brief, permitted reference assets and output constraints.
loop.output: Up to three illustration candidates with generation metadata.
loop.check: Check dimensions and file integrity; designer checks meaning, visual defects, rights and suitability.
loop.stop: One generation batch and one correction batch; unsuitable results return to manual drawing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Original illustrative content cannot be obtained by chart rules or template substitution alone.

steps.what: Refine composition, chart readability and illustration details in the design editor {OTHER}.
Export a proof and check technical settings in the design editor {OTHER}.
Check the proof and print through the print driver {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A portable artwork generator takes approved files from the {DOCS}, renders charts deterministically and uses a bounded image-generation loop in the creative tool {OTHER} for suitable illustration drafts. The designer refines the master; configured export checks preserve available provenance and require approval before printing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charts were redrawn by hand and creative files lacked consistent input contracts. Illustration generation also offered limited control over detail and repeatability.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding lowers the cost of chart renderers, asset importers and validation. Existing image generation can supply draft candidates, while export presets handle routine production.
tasks.still_hard: Precise technical illustrations, consistent characters and editable vector structure remain difficult. Generated drafts can require more correction than manual drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The designer decides what the image should communicate and catches misleading visual emphasis, poor composition and subtle drawing errors.

ambition.what: A recurring branded chart pack generated from approved campaign data.

tasks.altitude: The designer spends less time plotting data and preparing proofs, and more time on visual explanation. They can propose chart treatments earlier; publication and production spending retain existing approval rights.

reach.task: Turn campaign findings into accurate explanatory charts.
reach.learn: Denominators, uncertainty, axis choices and the limits of the source data.

reach.task: Prepare reliable artwork exports for publication.
reach.learn: Colour profiles, font handling and output specifications.

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images and attaches Content Credentials.
Enfocus PitStop Pro checks PDF production requirements and reports issues.
Deterministic chart generation can preserve numeric correspondence with supplied data.
The cited adoption study reports increased output alongside reduced average novelty; it does not establish savings here.

assumptions: The time split represents a mixed workload of charts and illustrative artwork; individual jobs may contain only one.
Charts use approved structured data; illustrations are promotional rather than safety-critical technical instructions.
Computer creation dominates this task, so the prior's large meeting share is reduced.
Available provenance metadata is retained through tested export paths.
Build ranges are estimates for one reusable chart family and one illustration workflow.
unknowns: The actual balance of charts, original illustrations and reusable artwork.
Whether current creative tools expose usable scripting and export interfaces.
Which assets may be sent to an image-generation service.
Whether personal images or employee data trigger additional GDPR review or national consultation requirements.
Who approves printing and any associated spending.
research_questions: Which export paths preserve provenance metadata across required artwork formats?
Which illustration categories consistently require less correction than drawing from scratch?
new_work: Maintain chart templates and validate data mappings.
Review generated artwork and record rejected candidates.
Check permitted asset use and applicable disclosure requirements.
Test export presets after creative-tool updates.
Monitor generation costs and manual fallback frequency.

tasks.short: Assemble final print layouts, resolve production defects, and release approved files to the printer.

steps.what: Locate approved copy, artwork and printer specifications.
Place approved content into the layout template using the page-layout editor {OTHER}.
Adjust typography, image placement and page balance in the page-layout editor {OTHER}.
Add production marks and export the print package using the page-layout editor {OTHER}.
Check the print package and correct defects using the preflight tool {OTHER}.
Inspect the final visual proof and record requested corrections.
Approve the exact file version and send the print package.

tasks.design: Configure template population and export presets in the page-layout editor {OTHER}, with approved inputs held in the {DOCS}. A configured preflight tool {OTHER} applies printer-specific checks, while the {WORKFLOW} releases only the exact approved file version through the {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Printer settings and approvals were scattered across files and mail. Reliable automation required consistent templates and a maintained production profile.
tasks.enabler_now: Template population, export presets and rule-based preflight already exist. AI coding makes the version checks and approval connection cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: Bespoke layouts, complex folds, spot colours and unusual finishing need production expertise. A technically valid file can still look wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The designer judges typography and visual balance, and recognises when production constraints damage the intended design.

ambition.what: Let event planners request approved-format print materials through a controlled intake form.

tasks.altitude: The designer spends less time placing routine content and packaging files, with more time for layout quality and production exceptions. Print-release authority stays with the existing approver.

reach.task: Resolve print-production defects before supplier handoff.
reach.learn: Preflight profiles, overprint, bleed, colour separation and packaging conventions.

reach.task: Specify event signage and printed collateral.
reach.learn: Viewing distance, physical dimensions, finishing requirements and supplier deadlines.

evidence.claim: Enfocus PitStop Pro checks PDF/X profiles, applies action lists and reports production issues.
Figma Buzz supports locked template areas and spreadsheet-fed variants, demonstrating controlled content substitution.
Template assembly and technical preflight can be automated while final visual judgement remains human.
Build ranges and remaining effort are estimates for a small set of recurring print formats.

assumptions: Digital page-layout assembly is typical; physical paste-up is exceptional.
Recurring formats have approved templates; bespoke refinement remains a separate human step.
Preflight automatically fixes only explicitly permitted, tested defects and preserves the original.
A changed file invalidates its previous release approval.
Routine file preparation uses system screens more than the meeting-heavy prior suggests.
unknowns: Which recurring formats have stable templates.
Whether printers supply machine-readable specifications or maintained profiles.
Which preflight corrections the team permits automatically.
Whether the designer may release files or another role must approve.
Whether employee consultation is required under applicable national rules.
research_questions: Which production defects can safely be corrected without changing visual intent?
How consistently do supplier profiles detect finishing-specific failures?
new_work: Maintain printer profiles and approved templates.
Verify that approval refers to the exact released file.
Test representative physical proofs when profiles or suppliers change.
Handle rejected deliveries and supplier specification changes.

tasks.short: Study photographs and illustrations to choose how products and services should be presented.

steps.what: Find candidate photographs and illustrations in the asset library.
Check usage records, dimensions and available crops.
Study visual meaning, audience fit and relationships between candidate images.
Build presentation studies using the design editor {OTHER}.
Compare studies and refine the proposed presentation in the design editor {OTHER}.
Discuss tradeoffs and approve the presentation direction.
Record selected asset versions and the agreed presentation direction.

tasks.design: Configure asset filters in the {DOCS} and template-based presentation studies in the design editor {OTHER}. Deterministic checks flag missing usage records and unsuitable dimensions, then the {WORKFLOW} records the human-selected direction and asset versions in the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Asset metadata was inconsistent, and building comparable studies required repetitive placement and resizing. Creative selection itself was never a reliable rules problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing template tools can generate controlled variants. AI coding reduces the effort of connecting asset metadata, technical checks and decision records without requiring a model.
tasks.still_hard: Symbolism, authenticity, audience interpretation and visual originality remain contextual. Usage records may be incomplete or require legal interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The designer sees how an image changes meaning beside copy, other images and a particular product promise.

ambition.what: Choose presentation direction after comparing all required channel crops in one review.

tasks.altitude: The designer spends less time finding usable files and constructing routine studies, with more time comparing visual narratives. They gain a stronger basis for recommendations; final direction approval stays with the marketing manager.

reach.task: Choose imagery that works across responsive layouts.
reach.learn: Focal points, text overlap, small-screen legibility and alternative text.

reach.task: Assess reputational implications of campaign imagery.
reach.learn: Representation, implied claims and context-sensitive interpretation.

evidence.claim: Figma Buzz supports locked template areas and variants populated from structured inputs.
Asset filtering, dimension checks and version capture can use deterministic rules.
Visual selection and contextual interpretation remain human judgement in this design.
Time shares, remaining effort and delivery ranges require validation against an actual asset workflow.

assumptions: An asset library is represented by the {DOCS}; it may initially be a folder plus a metadata file.
Search uses existing descriptive metadata, without facial identification.
Technical suitability checks flag missing rights evidence rather than interpreting licence prose.
Template previews accelerate comparison; final selection and bespoke refinement stay human.
The large meeting prior is reduced because substantial image study happens individually.
The approval meeting's time is included in the task estimate even though another role leads that step.
unknowns: How complete and reliable asset usage records are.
Which channel templates exist and who maintains them.
Who can approve the presentation direction.
Whether assets contain personal data requiring additional access controls.
Whether proposed changes require employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which crop-preview checks reliably identify hidden focal points or obstructed subjects?
Which asset metadata fields most improve retrieval without introducing unnecessary personal data?
new_work: Maintain descriptive metadata and usage records.
Resolve missing permissions and unsuitable asset dimensions.
Check that recorded decisions identify the correct asset versions.

role.altitude: The designer's week shifts from collection, repetitive assembly and file preparation toward audience interpretation, visual judgement and production exceptions. Existing approval rights remain; broader authority requires an explicit organisational decision.
reach: Work with market research analysts on evidence quality and accurate visual explanation.
Work with desktop publishers on dependable production profiles.
Work with web and digital interface designers on imagery across channels.
skills_to_grow: Asset rights, provenance and GDPR-aware handling.
Evaluation of generated artwork and manual fallback decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a reusable campaign artwork service that turns approved evidence, copy and assets into channel studies and production-ready drafts, with human decisions at audience interpretation, visual selection and release.
